notes: Attacker delivery host; Bitdefender; on the block list

description: URL of the k2f-agent payload bundle fetched through the launcher's server-pushed task channel.
notes: Attacker payload URL; Bitdefender; on the block list

description: SHA256 of the k2f-agent payload Bitdefender recovered from the campaign.

description: Path of the disguised log file that held the LuaJIT bytecode payload under the NIKKE Launcher log folder. The file is usually deleted within minutes.
notes: Look for .log files larger than about 50 KB whose first bytes are LuaJIT bytecode (\x1bLJ\x01); Bitdefender; alert only

description: Temporary database the stealer writes with collected browser credentials, including -wal, -shm and -journal siblings.
notes: Host artefact; often removed after the short collection window; Bitdefender; alert only

description: Payload build tag K2F_LUA_BUILD = "722b99d8d0e9" recovered from the decompiled k2f-agent source.
notes: Hunt this string in recovered Lua bundles or memory; Bitdefender; alert only
